# Dr Keith O'Brien — Executive Coach & Behavioural Scientist

> Evidence-based executive coaching for senior leaders, business owners and founders
> navigating transition, organisational change and AI disruption. London and virtual,
> worldwide. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute discovery call.

## Who he is

Keith O'Brien is a chartered psychologist and behavioural scientist with a PhD in the
psychology of decision-making and fifteen years applying behavioural science at senior
level across consulting, digital innovation and financial services. He currently leads
AI change and adoption for one of the UK's best-known consumer brands.

He trained as an executive coach at Henley Business School on the Professional Certificate
in Executive Coaching, the UK's only triple-accredited programme (ICF, AC and EMCC), and
coaches under regular supervision in line with the ICF Core Competencies and Code of Ethics.

## Who he works with

- Leaders stepping into a more senior or more complex role
- Executives navigating organisational change, restructuring or uncertainty
- Business owners and founders who have hit their goals and want to know what comes next
- Professionals returning to work or making a significant career shift
- Leaders who want more presence, clarity or confidence in how they lead
- Anyone leading through AI-era pressure and uncertainty

## How he works

Psychology first: the work addresses what is actually driving the behaviour rather than the
plan sitting on top of it. Engagements contract explicitly on what the client wants to be
different, review honestly at the midpoint, and end with something to act on every session.
Draws on solution-focused coaching, cognitive-behavioural techniques and behavioural science.

A coach, not a consultant or mentor: the client owns the agenda, the choices and the plan.

## Fees (GBP, inclusive, no VAT applicable)

- Discovery call, 30 minutes: free
- Transition Sprint, 3 sessions: £550
- Coaching Programme, 6 sessions: £1,050
- Organisational Leadership Programme, 6 sessions: £2,500 (includes three-way contracting
  with the sponsor, midpoint and close-out, and a before-and-after measure)
